target_customer: Businesses and app makers in emerging markets who want users to access apps without paying for mobile data; later cloud hosting customers in Nigeria
problem: Many people in emerging economies cannot afford data subscriptions, so they cannot use websites and apps. Simplifyd lets businesses cover the data, like a toll-free phone number.
business_model: Businesses pay for user data access (toll-free internet) and, later, usage-billed cloud hosting
product_category: Toll-free internet apps and cloud hosting

founders.name: Tomi Amao
founders.background_notes: Role as CEO per Nairametrics; YC page lists no title.

founders.name: Sam Keiru
founders.role: Co-founder and COO, Product Innovation and GTM Lead

founders.name: Mayowa Amao
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by Nairametrics, not on the YC page.

founders.name: Abiola Fajimi
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by Nairametrics, not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Facebook Free Basics
competitors.what: Zero-rated access to selected sites through mobile operators
competitors.traction_then: Surveys in eight countries found under 4 percent of respondents used zero-rated services; low awareness in Nigeria

technical_complexity.rationale: Delivering data-free app access needs integration with mobile network operators and billing, which is hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Operator agreements are slow to build and hard to replicate quickly, but the operator names and terms are not public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying Simplifyd. The company has since added cloud hosting in a Nigeria region.

market_need_then: Data affordability limited internet use in emerging economies, though a Nigeria survey cited found zero-rating awareness low and local data fairly cheap.

branding.domain_note: Owns simplifyd.com; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, benefit led: Your app, datafree

branding.brand_signature: Zerodata, the toll-free internet concept compared to toll-free phone calls
branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage in Nairametrics, TechCabal, BusinessDay and the Guardian Nigeria in March 2022.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear product concept and decent local press at launch, but the name resembles several unrelated companies.

pivots.from: Zerodata marketplace app for data-free access
pivots.to: Simplifyd Cloud, hosting with a Zerodata feature, region ng-west-1 in Nigeria
pivots.why: Not stated; the current site describes a cloud platform. Date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Simplifyd raised a half million dollar pre-seed from Future Africa and YC in March 2022 and launched Zerodata. The current site is a usage-billed cloud in Nigeria with Zerodata as a feature and no named customers, suggesting a widening from toll-free apps toward infrastructure. No later funding or customer metrics were found, so traction is unknown.
notes: Round seen in Nairametrics and Legit.ng (N207.5M). Founding year conflicts: YC says 2021, Nairametrics says 2020. VCBacked lists Hertford UK as location, unverified. Free Basics source is from 2015, the closest dated one found, so it shows the category rather than 2022 traction. Outcome search found no news on shutdown or acquisition.
